    (hbeta : 0 < beta) (hab : ∀ i, a i < b i)
    (hsep : ∀ i : Fin (2 * k), b i.succ ≤ a i.castSucc)
    (hbu : b 0 ≤ u)
    (hprod : (∑ i : Fin (2 * k), b i.castSucc) ≤ beta)
    (hprefix : ∀ i : Fin (2 * k), Even i.val →
      (∑ j : Fin (2 * k) with j.val < i.val, b j.castSucc) + 3 * b i.castSucc ≤ beta)
    (hshell : beta ≤ (∑ i : Fin (2 * k), a i.castSucc) +
      3 * a (Fin.last (2 * k)))

    {p : Fin (2 * k + 1) → ℕ} (hp : p ∈ actualPrimeBoxTuples N a b) :
    p (Fin.last (2 * k)) ∈ actualSmallPrimeFinset N cap ((N : ℝ) ^ u) ∧
      actualRosserOddTail p ∈
        (((actualSmallPrimeFinset N cap ((N : ℝ) ^ u)).filter
          (fun q => p (Fin.last (2 * k)) < q)).powerset.filter

              (p (Fin.last (2 * k))))) ∧
      (actualRosserOddTail p).card = 2 * k

:= by

  have hNpos : (0 : ℝ) < N := zero_lt_one.trans hNreal
  have hm := mem_actualPrimeBoxTuples_iff.mp hp
  have hanti := actualPrimeBoxTuples_strictAnti (by omega : 1 ≤ N) hsep hp
  have hP (i : Fin (2 * k + 1)) :

    rw [mem_actualSmallPrimeFinset_iff_of_cutoff_le_cap hcap]

      (Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_le hNreal.le (odd_box_upper_le hab hsep hbu i))⟩
  have hpPos (i : Fin (2 * k + 1)) : (0 : ℝ) < p i := by
    exact_mod_cast (hm i).1.pos
  have hprodLE (S : Finset (Fin (2 * k))) :
      (∏ i ∈ S, (p i.castSucc : ℝ)) ≤
        (N : ℝ) ^ (∑ i ∈ S, b i.castSucc) := by
    rw [Real.rpow_sum_of_pos hNpos]
    exact Finset.prod_le_prod (fun i _ => (hpPos _).le)
      (fun i _ => (hm i.castSucc).2.2.2.le)
  have htotalReal : (∏ i : Fin (2 * k), (p i.castSucc : ℝ)) < (N : ℝ) ^ beta := by
    by_cases hk : k = 0
    · subst k
      simpa using Real.one_lt_rpow hNreal hbeta
    · calc
        (∏ i : Fin (2 * k), (p i.castSucc : ℝ)) <
            ∏ i : Fin (2 * k), (N : ℝ) ^ b i.castSucc := by
          exact Finset.prod_lt_prod_of_nonempty (fun i _ => hpPos _)
            (fun i _ => (hm i.castSucc).2.2.2)
            ⟨⟨0, by omega⟩, Finset.mem_univ _⟩
        _ = (N : ℝ) ^ (∑ i : Fin (2 * k), b i.castSucc) :=
          (Real.rpow_sum_of_pos hNpos _ _).symm
        _ ≤ (N : ℝ) ^ beta := Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_le hNreal.le hprod
  have hprefixReal (i : Fin (2 * k)) (hi : Even i.val) :
      (∏ j : Fin (2 * k) with j.val < i.val, (p j.castSucc : ℝ)) *
          (p i.castSucc : ℝ) ^ 3 < (N : ℝ) ^ beta := by
    have hcube : (p i.castSucc : ℝ) ^ 3 < ((N : ℝ) ^ b i.castSucc) ^ 3 :=
      pow_lt_pow_left₀ (hm i.castSucc).2.2.2 (hpPos _).le (by decide)
    calc
      _ ≤ ((N : ℝ) ^ (∑ j : Fin (2 * k) with j.val < i.val, b j.castSucc)) *
          (p i.castSucc : ℝ) ^ 3 :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hprodLE _) (by positivity)
      _ < ((N : ℝ) ^ (∑ j : Fin (2 * k) with j.val < i.val, b j.castSucc)) *
          ((N : ℝ) ^ b i.castSucc) ^ 3 :=
        mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left hcube (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hNpos _)
      _ = (N : ℝ) ^ ((∑ j : Fin (2 * k) with j.val < i.val, b j.castSucc) +

        rw [Real.rpow_add hNpos, show 3 * b i.castSucc = b i.castSucc * (3 : ℕ) by ring,
          Real.rpow_mul_natCast hNpos.le]
      _ ≤ (N : ℝ) ^ beta := Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_le hNreal.le (hprefix i hi)
  have hshellReal : (N : ℝ) ^ beta ≤
      (∏ i : Fin (2 * k), (p i.castSucc : ℝ)) * (p (Fin.last (2 * k)) : ℝ) ^ 3 := by
    calc
      (N : ℝ) ^ beta ≤ (N : ℝ) ^ ((∑ i : Fin (2 * k), a i.castSucc) +
          3 * a (Fin.last (2 * k))) :=
        Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_le hNreal.le hshell
      _ = (∏ i : Fin (2 * k), (N : ℝ) ^ a i.castSucc) *
          ((N : ℝ) ^ a (Fin.last (2 * k))) ^ 3 := by
        rw [Real.rpow_add hNpos, Real.rpow_sum_of_pos hNpos,
          show 3 * a (Fin.last (2 * k)) = a (Fin.last (2 * k)) * (3 : ℕ) by ring,
          Real.rpow_mul_natCast hNpos.le]
      _ ≤ _ := mul_le_mul
        (Finset.prod_le_prod (fun _ _ => (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hNpos _).le)
          (fun i _ => (hm i.castSucc).2.2.1))
        (pow_le_pow_left₀ (Real.rpow_nonneg hNpos.le _)
          (hm (Fin.last (2 * k))).2.2.1 3) (by positivity) (by positivity)
  let l := List.ofFn (fun i : Fin (2 * k) => p i.castSucc)
  have hlinj : Function.Injective (fun i : Fin (2 * k) => p i.castSucc) :=
    hanti.injective.comp (Fin.castSucc_injective (2 * k))
  have hlsorted : l.SortedGT := by
    apply List.sortedGT_iff_pairwise.mpr
    exact List.pairwise_ofFn.mpr (fun _ _ hij => hanti (Fin.castSucc_lt_castSucc_iff.mpr hij))
  have hlfinset : l.toFinset = actualRosserOddTail p := by
    ext r
    simp only [l, List.mem_toFinset, List.mem_ofFn, actualRosserOddTail,
      Finset.mem_image, Finset.mem_univ, true_and]
  have hsort : (actualRosserOddTail p).sort (· ≥ ·) = l := by
    rw [← hlfinset]

      hlsorted.sortedGE.pairwise

      (p (Fin.last (2 * k))) l :=

      hlsorted htotalReal hprefixReal hshellReal

    intro hq
    obtain ⟨i, _, hi⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hq
    exact (Fin.castSucc_ne_last i) (hanti.injective hi)
  have hqmin : ∀ r ∈ actualRosserOddTail p, p (Fin.last (2 * k)) ≤ r := by
    intro r hr
    obtain ⟨i, _, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hr
    exact (hanti i.castSucc_lt_last).le
  have hboundary : LinearSieve.UpperRosserBoundarySet (Nat.ceil ((N : ℝ) ^ beta))
      (p (Fin.last (2 * k))) (actualRosserOddTail p) := by
    apply (LinearSieve.upperRosserBoundarySet_iff_sorted_chain hqnot
      (hm (Fin.last (2 * k))).1 hqmin).mpr
    rwa [hsort]
  refine ⟨hP _, Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_powerset.mpr ?_, hboundary⟩,
    actualRosserOddTail_card hanti.injective⟩
  intro r hr
  obtain ⟨i, _, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hr
  exact Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨hP _, hanti i.castSucc_lt_last⟩

end

import ImbalancedChen.RoughPrimeUniverse
import ImbalancedChen.SmallRoughAttachment
import MathlibNt.SieveTheory.LiLiuPrereqWFSmallRosser
import Mathlib.Data.Nat.GCD.BigOperators
import Mathlib.Data.Int.Basic

/-- The real, strictly bounded small-prime carrier. The natural `cap` only
enumerates the primes; a theorem below removes it from the predicate. -/
def actualSmallPrimeFinset (N cap : ℕ) (w : ℝ) : Finset ℕ :=
  roughPrimeFinset N cap 0 w

@[simp] theorem mem_actualSmallPrimeFinset {N cap p : ℕ} {w : ℝ} :
    p ∈ actualSmallPrimeFinset N cap w ↔
      p < cap ∧ Nat.Prime p ∧ ¬p ∣ N ∧ (p : ℝ) < w := by
  simp [actualSmallPrimeFinset, Nat.cast_nonneg]

theorem mem_actualSmallPrimeFinset_iff_of_cutoff_le_cap
    {N cap p : ℕ} {w : ℝ} (hwcap : w ≤ (cap : ℝ)) :
    p ∈ actualSmallPrimeFinset N cap w ↔
      Nat.Prime p ∧ ¬p ∣ N ∧ (p : ℝ) < w := by
  simpa only [actualSmallPrimeFinset, Nat.cast_nonneg, true_and] using
    (mem_roughPrimeFinset_iff_of_cutoff_le_cap
      (N := N) (cap := cap) (p := p) (w := (0 : ℝ)) hwcap)

import ImbalancedChen.ActualPrimeReciprocalMass
import Mathlib.Algebra.BigOperators.Ring.Finset
import Mathlib.Order.Fin.Basic
import Mathlib.Data.Nat.Totient
import Mathlib.Data.Nat.GCD.BigOperators
import ImbalancedChen.FinitePrimeGeometryCore

theorem actualPrimeBoxTuples_strictAnti {N k : ℕ} {a b : Fin (k + 1) → ℝ}
    {p : Fin (k + 1) → ℕ} (hN : 1 ≤ N)
    (hsep : ∀ i : Fin k, b i.succ ≤ a i.castSucc)
    (hp : p ∈ actualPrimeBoxTuples N a b) : StrictAnti p := by
  apply Fin.strictAnti_iff_succ_lt.mpr
  intro i
  have hp' := mem_actualPrimeBoxTuples_iff.mp hp
  have hN' : (1 : ℝ) ≤ N := by exact_mod_cast hN
  have hexp := Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_le hN' (hsep i)
  have hlt := (hp' i.succ).2.2.2.trans_le
    (hexp.trans (hp' i.castSucc).2.2.1)
  exact_mod_cast hlt

import ImbalancedChen.FirstExitDepthSplice
import ImbalancedChen.FirstExitPresieveProjection
import ImbalancedChen.RoughPrimeUniverse
import ImbalancedChen.LogPrimeBoxMesh
import MathlibNt.SieveTheory.LiLiuPrereqWFSmallRosser
import Mathlib.Data.List.GetD
import Mathlib.Data.List.OfFn
import Mathlib.Order.Fin.Basic
import Mathlib.Algebra.BigOperators.Fin
import Mathlib.Analysis.SpecialFunctions.Pow.Real

/-- The actual finite carrier of prime tuples in a logarithmic box. -/
def actualPrimeBoxTuples (N : ℕ) {k : ℕ} (a b : Fin k → ℝ) :
    Finset (Fin k → ℕ) :=
  Fintype.piFinset (fun i =>
    roughPrimeFinset N (Nat.ceil ((N : ℝ) ^ b i))
      ((N : ℝ) ^ a i) ((N : ℝ) ^ b i))

/-- Membership retains primality, the common target exclusion, and both
exact endpoints. Enumeration caps add no truncation. -/
theorem mem_actualPrimeBoxTuples_iff {N k : ℕ} {a b : Fin k → ℝ}
    {p : Fin k → ℕ} :
    p ∈ actualPrimeBoxTuples N a b ↔
      ∀ i, Nat.Prime (p i) ∧ ¬p i ∣ N ∧
        (N : ℝ) ^ a i ≤ (p i : ℝ) ∧ (p i : ℝ) < (N : ℝ) ^ b i := by
  simp only [actualPrimeBoxTuples, Fintype.mem_piFinset,
    mem_roughPrimeFinset_iff_of_cutoff_le_cap (Nat.le_ceil _)]

/-- The selected even sets above the distinguished least prime that first
cross an upper Rosser constraint at the exact ceiling level. -/
def actualUpperRosserBoundarySets (N cap : ℕ) (y R : ℝ) (q : ℕ) :
    Finset (Finset ℕ) :=
  ((actualSmallPrimeFinset N cap y).filter (fun p => q < p)).powerset.filter
    (LinearSieve.UpperRosserBoundarySet (Nat.ceil R) q)

theorem upperRosserBoundarySet_iff_sorted_chain
    {D q : ℕ} {s : Finset ℕ} (hqs : q ∉ s) (hqprime : q.Prime)
    (hqmin : ∀ p ∈ s, q ≤ p) :
    UpperRosserBoundarySet D q s ↔
      UpperRosserBoundaryChain D q (s.sort (· ≥ ·)) := by
  rw [upperRosserBoundarySet_iff_cube_le hqs hqprime hqmin]
  have hprod : (s.sort (· ≥ ·)).prod = s.prod id := by
    simpa using
      (List.prod_toFinset id (Finset.sort_nodup s (· ≥ ·))).symm
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨heven, hprodD, hadm, hcube⟩
    refine ⟨Finset.sortedGT_sort s, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · simpa using heven
    · simpa [hprod] using hprodD
    · intro i hi
      exact upperRosserAdmissibleSet_iff_sorted_prefix_cube_lt.mp hadm
        i.val i.isLt hi
    · simpa [hprod] using hcube
  · rintro ⟨hsorted, heven, hprodD, hadm, hcube⟩
    refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · simpa using heven
    · simpa [hprod] using hprodD
    · apply upperRosserAdmissibleSet_iff_sorted_prefix_cube_lt.mpr
      intro i hi hiEven
      exact hadm ⟨i, hi⟩ hiEven
    · simpa [hprod] using hcube

/-- The standard upper Rosser test on a finite set of distinct primes.  The
test is imposed at odd positions in the decreasing list: at
`p = p_{2l+1}` it says `p₁⋯p_{2l} * p_{2l+1}^3 < D`. -/
def UpperRosserAdmissibleSet (D : ℕ) (s : Finset ℕ) : Prop :=
  ∀ p ∈ s, ¬Even ((s.filter (fun q => p ≤ q)).card) →
    (s.filter (fun q => p ≤ q)).prod id * p ^ 2 < D

/-- The upper Rosser test for the prime factors of a natural number. -/
def UpperRosserAdmissible (D d : ℕ) : Prop :=
  UpperRosserAdmissibleSet D d.primeFactors

/-- The upper Rosser coefficient attached to a finite set of distinct primes. -/
noncomputable def upperRosserSetWeight (D : ℕ) (s : Finset ℕ) : ℝ :=
  if s.prod id < D ∧ UpperRosserAdmissibleSet D s then
    if Even s.card then 1 else -1
  else 0

/-- The even Rosser boundary exposed when a new least prime is inserted: the
old set is active, but adjoining `q` crosses either the level or an odd-position
Rosser constraint. -/
def UpperRosserBoundarySet (D q : ℕ) (s : Finset ℕ) : Prop :=
  Even s.card ∧
    s.prod id < D ∧ UpperRosserAdmissibleSet D s ∧
    ¬((insert q s).prod id < D ∧
      UpperRosserAdmissibleSet D (insert q s))

/-- The explicit ordered-chain region underlying one upper Rosser boundary
term.  This is the finite region that is later reindexed and compared with the
Buchstab nested integrals. -/
def UpperRosserBoundaryChain (D q : ℕ) (l : List ℕ) : Prop :=
  l.SortedGT ∧ Even l.length ∧ l.prod < D ∧
    (∀ i : Fin l.length, Even i.val →
      (l.take i.val).prod * (l.get i) ^ 3 < D) ∧
    D ≤ l.prod * q ^ 3
